ops.body:
- **T? [owner] A memo with no place of its own plays where its start time falls on the path** (2026-11-20)
  Area: replay. Seen: the T41 review's steward, silent question 3 (`unsaved-bar-saving-replay-watch-again-settled`, the `unsaved` journey, `/tend inbox` T41, Nov 20): a memo kept with no fix of its own is told at the path's end. `src/lib/ceremony/story.ts` l.264 already places a moment with no place at `positionAt(path, tFirst)`, which waits at the end of the run before a gap (`walkerAt`, `src/lib/replay.ts`), so the build first finds which case such a memo meets: a start time inside the trace, or one after its last fix (then the run before it is where the walker was last known). Rests on: the owner's answer, in person, 2026-11-20, "Place it by its time"; VISION.md, Honour: "Keep a moment where and when it happened"; Return: "truthfully".
  Recommended: a memo with no fix in the last 15 s (`pieceStamp.ts` l.22) and none found after plays at the point of the path its start time falls on, not after the last fix; its pin on the card stands there too; no new words. /vision: aligned (Honour, where and when it happened; Return, truthfully; no word, control or count added).
  Precedent: Relive pops a route's photos up along the line where they were taken (from memory, not yet recorded); Polarsteps puts a trip's steps on its route (from memory, unverified; `docs/research/adjacent-apps.md`, "Replay a walk; moments on a map").
  Otherwise: leave it where the path ends.
Nov 20: the owner's yes, in person, 2026-11-20: "Place it by its time (Recommended)". Waits for a build.

- [loop] **A corner bubble stands tight above the scale bar and the map's info button** (the T41 review's ux U3, Nov 20, low, opinion; existing behaviour, not the T41 change): a loose moment's memo bubble on a walk with no trace sits at `insets.bottom + STAGE_BOTTOM` (`components/ceremony/Bubbles.tsx` l.166), its foot a few px over "100 m" and the (i) (picture `unsaved-bar-saving-replay-watch-again-settled`, 390 px). Test: `tend replay audit N: a corner bubble clears the scale bar by the stage's gap`.

argv: A memo save that never settles holds Start and Walk here for good
ops.body:
- [loop] **A capture that lands in a walk after its replay snapped it is not counted on the card or the walk's row, and may never be placed** (`/tend inbox` T41 build, Nov 20, medium; fails E-replay-1; the T41 review's steward S1, ux U2 and auditor call 8; the next replay build). A memo saved through the bar's Stop (decision 0227) lands after the replay's snap: the walk's summary, written at the snap (`finish.ts` l.126-146), counts the walk's moments before the memo's row exists, and the replay derives it again only with no summary, no build or a new build (`replay/[id].tsx` l.371), so the card's kept clause and the walk's row (`walkRowMeta`) say nothing of the memo the replay now plays (`tend replay T41`), until any moment of that walk is deleted, which recounts the kinds from the rows (`countsOf`, `db/index.web.ts` l.402, l.574; `sqliteStore.ts` l.266, l.396). A memo started with no fix in the last 15 s (`pieceStamp.ts` l.22) whose one-fix read finds none is never placed on the trace either, since the snap that places moments by time ran before it. Seen: the unsaved journey's pictures `unsaved-bar-saving-replay-landed` and `-taken-in-390` (the card reads "0 m · 24 s", no kept clause, with the memo in the walk). AGENTS.md, "Truth vs cache" ("recompute from the trace, never patch derived data"); VISION.md, Always, "**Moments and the trace are truth**; streets, areas and summaries are recomputed". Shape (the steward's): a capture kept into an ended walk sets `snapped_build: null`; the open replay's read again (`replayArrivals`), finding the walk unsnapped, runs the opener's snap before it shows it; no new words. Beside it, the auditor's F3: deleting a late capture from the card under-says another of its kind, since `summaryLess` subtracts a capture the summary never counted (`replay/[id].tsx` l.84, `deletion/core.ts` l.82); the re-derivation removes the cause. Tests: `tend tabs audit N: a memo landing in an ended walk is counted and placed at its next replay` (unit) and `tend replay audit 20: deleting a memo that landed after the snap leaves an earlier memo said on the card`.
  - The owner, in person 2026-11-20: the clause may catch up while the card is open; only new copy is forbidden.

- **T51 [owner] A memo with no place of its own plays where its start time falls on the path** (2026-11-20)
  Area: replay. Seen: the T41 review's steward, silent question 3 (`unsaved-bar-saving-replay-watch-again-settled`, the `unsaved` journey, `/tend inbox` T41, Nov 20): a memo kept with no fix of its own is told at the path's end. `src/lib/ceremony/story.ts` l.264 already places a moment with no place at `positionAt(path, tFirst)`, which waits at the end of the run before a gap (`walkerAt`, `src/lib/replay.ts`), so the build first finds which case such a memo meets: a start time inside the trace, or one after its last fix (then the run before it is where the walker was last known). Rests on: the owner's answer, in person, 2026-11-20, "Place it by its time"; VISION.md, Honour: "Keep a moment where and when it happened"; Return: "truthfully".
  Recommended: a memo with no fix in the last 15 s (`pieceStamp.ts` l.22) and none found after plays at the point of the path its start time falls on, not after the last fix; its pin on the card stands there too; no new words. /vision: aligned (Honour, where and when it happened; Return, truthfully; no word, control or count added).
  Precedent: Relive, a route replayed as a video, "its photos popping up along the line" (unverified), and Polarsteps, "a trip drawn as a route with steps" (unverified), `docs/research/adjacent-apps.md`, "Replay a walk; moments on a map"; neither records where a photo with no place stands (not yet recorded).
  Otherwise: leave it where the path ends.
  Nov 20: the owner's yes, in person, 2026-11-20: "Place it by its time (Recommended)". Waits for a build.

**Nov 20, `/tend inbox T41 yes --deploy=main`, one build** (opened from `a556714e`, rebased onto `10bbaa28` at the diff pause; lenses 0 and 7's build only; lenses 1-6 belong to a sweep and were not run).
- T41, the owner's yes in person Nov 19 ("Yes, as recommended"), built: `tend replay T41` the open replay hears its walk on the capture bus; a capture kept after it opened (a memo still being saved through the bar's Stop, decision 0227) is read in on the card, pinned there where it has a place, and played in the next Watch again; while the walk is told it waits for the card; no word, no indicator, the beats and their order unchanged. The card's kept clause catches up only with the late-capture `[loop]` fix in `docs/DEFERRED.md` ("Tabs and the recording bar"), the next replay build. The owner, in person 2026-11-20, "Being in the walk is enough": a memo that lands mid-telling is not owed a telling of its own; every later replay plays it.
- Lens 0: the replay had no line; three drafted (`docs/expectations/replay.md`, proposed), the first reworded by the steward, the second's grounds corrected. E-replay-1 failed (provisional): every moment is played and pinned (`tend replay T41`), but the card's kept clause does not say a memo that landed late (its defect, the late-capture item). E-replay-2 met (RR7, the `replay` journey). E-replay-3 met (`tabs audit U13`, `npm test`).
- The review (one round; the auditor, the ux-reviewer and the steward): `tend replay audit 17` the unsaved journey's memo now has a place and is pinned on the card when it comes, in view above the sheet, the hint with it, the buttons unmoved, the map not refitted; `18` a read begun on the card that settles after Watch again waits for the next card (the ear, `replayArrivals`, tested by its end effect); `19` a memo landing during the telling is not played in it and is played in the next Watch again. Deferred: the late capture never counted or placed (medium, with the auditor's F3 inside it), the corner bubble over the scale bar (low, existing). Rejected: sequencing the gap reloads' reads (no failing input).
- Filed: T51 (a memo with no place of its own plays where its start time falls on the path; the owner's yes in person Nov 20, waits for a build); `[loop]` in "Tabs and the recording bar" (the late capture, medium, the owner's "only new copy is forbidden" noted) and in "Replay ceremony" (the corner bubble, low).
- Waiting for builds, one per run: T42, T44, T45, T48, T49, T50 (the owner's yeses) and T51.
- The balance, as the last sweep read it: outgrowing its base (ten areas rough); an inbox run moves no area's state.
- Journeys on the final build: unsaved, replay, launch.
